lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear arrangement of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gills, organized into approximately five horizontal rows with centroids spaced at regular intervals along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light-toned vertical bands intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three well-defined longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the upper surface and shadowing beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin mask contains scattered, low-density high-luminance blobs, primarily localized toward the posterior and basal regions of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two remoras attached to the ventral region near the pectoral and pelvic fin insertions.
